vision.heading: Ensuring clean indoor air in every sector is our challenge and vision
paragraphs: The Basic Air team has been working in the clean air segment since 2009. We develop the most suitable indoor air purification projects across all areas of everyday and working environments, such as hospitals, dental practices, social care centres, schools, universities, hotels, restaurants and retail locations.

Air purification is essential for a productive indoor workplace. The Basic Air team's task is to help your organisation keep on-site work going by reducing airborne transferable viruses and making the environment safer for both employees and clients. HEPA filtration is ideally suited to capturing coronavirus particles, whether they are airborne aerosols or larger droplet forms.

Ensuring and monitoring clean indoor air is the main goal of our cooperation partners. The Swedish company Camfil is one of the largest players in the industry, with more than 50 years of experience. Camfil products stand out with ascetic Scandinavian design and impeccable quality, using the latest methods such as room airflow simulation and visualisation, as well as scientific testing.
The manufacturer has succeeded in developing an optimal air purification solution for every challenge.
